## Learn this first

```js
const projectName = "LearnForge";
function projectLabel(name) {
  return `Project: ${name}`;
}
console.log(projectLabel(projectName));
```

`const` connects a name to a value. `function` defines a callable unit; `name` receives the argument. Braces contain its body. `return` gives text back; the outer `console.log` displays it. `${name}` inserts that value into the text.
